rules.quote: 2.1 Timekeepers may bill only at the rates approved for them in the matter's rate schedule.
(b) The Company will not be charged for work performed by first-year associates, summer associates and law clerks.
(d) The Company will pay for at most 2 attorneys attending any deposition.
3.1 Time shall be billed in tenth-of-an-hour (0.1) increments.
4.1 Clerical tasks (including filing, copying, scheduling, organizing files, labeling and binder preparation) are not billable, even when performed by attorneys or paralegals.
5.1 Non-working travel time will be paid at 50% of the approved hourly rate.
6.1 The Company will not reimburse charges for word processing and meals.
(b) Copying will be reimbursed at a maximum of $0.20 per page.
(b) Invoices submitted more than 45 days after the end of the billing period will be rejected.
(c) Billing in excess of the approved budget requires prior written approval of the Law Department.
